full_prompt_en: A square ink-and-wash figure study shows a seated man leaning forward with his head supported by one hand against a mostly bare warm-white paper ground. The background remains open, carrying only a faint secondary outline behind his head and a few searching construction marks around the shoulders and lower edge. The man sits left of center with one knee raised toward the right. His head tips downward, eyes closed, and dark short hair is touched by blue-gray and ochre wash. The right elbow rests on the raised knee, bringing the hand to his temple, while the other arm drops loosely toward the lower center. He wears a light, open-neck shirt with sleeves rolled above the forearms and dark blue-gray trousers. The shirt's folds are mapped with quick thin lines and transparent beige, cool gray, and blue-green shadows; much of the paper remains visible through them. The exposed face, neck, and hands receive the densest warm ochre and brown modeling, built from overlapping angular strokes that describe bone and muscle without polishing them smooth. The trousers are more opaque and weighty, anchoring the otherwise airy drawing. Incomplete outlines at the left and lower edge show where a surrounding seat or further folds might have been considered, but no finished environment is fixed. Light is soft and diffuse from the upper left, leaving small shadows beneath the brow, nose, arm, and knee. Ink lines vary from crisp dark accents around the eyes and fingers to pale exploratory traces that drift away. The overall composition feels intimate and unfinished, using a concentrated diagonal body shape within generous blank paper to convey quiet fatigue.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形墨线淡彩人物习作描绘一名男子坐着前倾，以一手支撑头部，背景大多是裸露的暖白纸面。背景保持敞开，头后只有淡淡的第二道轮廓，肩部和下边缘留着几笔探寻性的结构线。男子坐在中央偏左，一条膝盖抬向右侧。头向下倾，眼睛闭着，深色短发点有蓝灰与赭黄薄涂。右肘支在抬起的膝上，把手带到太阳穴；另一只手臂松松垂向下方中央。他穿浅色敞领衬衫，袖子卷过前臂，配深蓝灰长裤。衬衫衣褶由快速细线以及透明米色、冷灰和蓝绿色暗部标出，大量纸面从中显露。裸露的脸、颈和手承载最密集的暖赭与棕色塑形，重叠有棱角的笔触描述骨骼肌肉，却没有将其磨成光滑表面。长裤更不透明、更有重量，为原本通透的绘画定下重心。左侧和下边缘未完成的轮廓显示曾考虑过周围座位或更多褶层，但没有确定完成的环境。光线从左上方柔和漫射，在眉下、鼻下、手臂和膝部留下小片阴影。墨线从眼和手指附近清晰的深色重音，变化到逐渐漂开的浅色试探痕迹。整体构图亲密而未完成，以宽裕空白纸面中的集中斜向身体形态传达安静的疲惫。
style_prompt_en: The drawing combines fine exploratory line with transparent watercolor-like washes on a warm pale ground. Some contours are decisively dark, while others repeat lightly, break off, or remain as visible construction traces. Ochre, sepia, blue-gray, and subdued green build volume in thin overlapping planes, leaving broad untouched areas bright and open. Concentrated hatch and wash define the focal mass, then taper toward unfinished margins. Light is diffuse and directional enough to place small cool shadows under projecting forms without hard theatrical contrast. The balance between richly worked passages and blank paper creates breathing room and a sense of process. The overall effect is observant, vulnerable, and tactile, with accuracy of gesture carried by economical marks.
style_prompt_zh: 这种绘画在暖浅色底上结合细密探寻线条与透明水彩般薄涂。有些轮廓明确深重，有些则浅浅重复、中途断开，或作为可见的结构草线保留。赭黄、乌贼棕、蓝灰和低调绿色以薄薄交叠平面建立体积，留下宽阔未触及区域明亮敞开。密集排线与罩染界定焦点体块，随后向未完成边缘渐渐减少。光线漫射而带方向性，在凸起形态下安置小片冷影，却不形成戏剧化硬对比。充分描绘的区域与空白纸面之间的平衡带来呼吸空间和创作过程感。整体效果细致、脆弱而有触感，姿态的准确性由节省的笔迹承担。
theme_en: A weary seated man in an unfinished ink-and-wash study
theme_zh: 一幅未完成墨线淡彩习作中疲惫坐着的男子
name: Sylvie Guillot
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
